notes: Zero recorded demos of any gated DGN tool (Developer Center, Partner Product Portal, EASI, Release Compliance Tool, Disputes Portal, eCentral, Fraud and Risk Center) were found on YouTube. Discover has no partner-facing YouTube presence; its official channel is consumer/brand/careers. The most revealing public material is the Fraud and Risk Center login page, which lists all acquirer/issuer tools and hostnames, and the Developer Center FAQ, which documents a rep-mediated, non-self-serve onboarding with no public sandbox. Gaps: WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted before this run (five queries refused), DuckDuckGo returned CAPTCHAs (not completed), and Bing returned only discover.com consumer pages, so Vimeo, SlideShare/Speaker Deck, BrightTALK, conference archives, app-store listings, processor-republished user guides and court exhibits were not surveyed. Upload dates for kept videos could not be fetched (the batch call returned nothing). Capital One's ownership since 2025 surfaced only as cardholder transition content. Recommend a follow-up run with web search restored, targeting: discovereasi.com, portal.discoverglobalnetwork.com, DiscovereCentral.com, advancedpayments.discoverglobalnetwork.com, and processor-hosted PDFs (e.g. 'Discover Network Dispute Rules', 'EASI user guide').
